label: copy phase, re-fed token among g/r/o/2/t/3/c (necessary condition only)
explanation: Very weak, sparse unit (max excess over threshold 0.004; 0.26% of steps). Fires only in the copy phase (never in original or delimiter steps, never at recall_idx 0, never on a first occurrence of the input token). Fed-back input tokens g, r, o, 2, t, 3, c carry ~80% of the mass, but these tokens are present on ~128k copy steps and the unit fires on only ~2% of them, so this is a necessary-ish condition rather than an explanation. Rates are much higher for L=3 (5.6%, mostly at the final step t=5) and at the last step of L=9 (t=17), and activations are largest at L=3 when the re-fed token is in the set (precision ~0.7 on that small slice, but only ~25% of mass). No positional, length, or token predicate tested (9 total) reached F1 above ~0.23; the firing likely depends on finer hidden-state detail than the available variables capture.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by step (t=13: g, r, o, t; t=14: g, r, o, 3; t=12: g, r, o, 2) and the previous input (most: j, z, g, q, 2, b; least: o, s, <DEL>, d); timing cues that raise it most: L=3 & t=5, L=3, L=4 & t=6.
